payload.author: experimental_development
payload.hypothesis: A compact transformer with a convolutional tokenizer (4x4 kernel, stride 4, 49 tokens) will outperform both the ResNet-18 and the multi-scale transformer on 28x28 histopathology classification because: (1) the conv tokenizer preserves spatial locality during tokenization, better capturing nuclear morphology and local texture patterns that distinguish confusable classes (background/debris/mucus, smooth muscle/stroma); (2) 49 tokens on a 7x7 grid provides sufficient spatial resolution for attention to model local tissue architecture without the overfitting risk of 196 tokens; (3) depth=4 with hidden=128 provides more sequential processing capacity than the multi-scale transformer's depth=2, enabling more complex feature interactions; (4) the single-scale design avoids the cross-scale attention overhead that may have diluted the multi-scale transformer's performance.
